name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump to appeal White House ballroom ruling to Supreme Court
changes.summary: After a federal appeals court halted construction of the White House ballroom on Friday, President Trump said he would appeal the ruling to the Supreme Court. Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: President Trump receives big cheers from spectators during LIV Golf event at his New Jersey club
changes.summary: LIV Golf is hosting its New York event at President Donald Trump’s National Golf Club Bedminster. It's the third time that the upstart tour has held an event at one of the president's golf clubs. As was the case at one previous event, President Trump himself was on hand to check things out. TRUMP DRAWS MUCH DIFFERENT R.

changes.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
changes.summary: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants. (Image credit: Bebeto Matthews).

changes.title: Minnesota GOP divided over Mike Lindell's potential gubernatorial nomination
changes.summary: Mike Lindell of "MyPillow" fame, might win the GOP primary for Minnesota governor running on a Trump platform. Other Republicans are concerned that his closeness could hurt his chances in November.

changes.title: Blanche Is Confirmed as Attorney General After Overcoming G.O.P. Concerns
changes.summary: Todd Blanche, who has served as acting attorney general since April, eked out Senate approval, despite growing unease about his willingness to rein in President Trump.

changes.title: Fact-Checking 3 Competitive Senate Races in Maine, Michigan and Ohio
changes.summary: Republican attacks have focused on terrorism and illegal immigration, while Democrats have sought to capitalize on the unpopularity of President Trump’s cuts to Medicaid.

changes.title: Trump Officials Under Pressure to Deport Haitians After Supreme Court Win on T.P.S. Program
changes.summary: The lack of visible raids aggressively targeting Haitians who lost temporary status has frustrated some of President Trump’s most fervent supporters.

changes.title: What to know about Trump's new attempt to limit birthright citizenship
changes.summary: A Supreme Court decision in June struck down a previous attempt at restricting birthright citizenship, but Thursday's orders were made with "adjustments" keeping the decision in mind, President Donald Trump said.

changes.title: Senate Bows to Reality, Leaving Trump’s Voting Bill Undone
changes.summary: The summer exit confirmed what had been apparent for weeks: that Republicans lacked the votes to pass the voting restrictions the president has made a top priority.

changes.title: Trump announces $180 million to boost mining education
changes.summary: President Trump announced over $180 million in grants to boost educational programs for the mining industry, part of a bid to increase critical mineral production.
